note: --compare (2026-11-25, at the user's request, the basis of the D-050 decision for option (b)): option (c) (R1.6, 16 mm shells with 1.0 mm chamfers, 14 mm land; its FE convergence is kept as `semicircle_r16_option_c`) against option (b) (R2.5 on the journal, unchamfered shells narrowed to fit: the largest width in 0.1 mm steps that keeps the same axial allowance, `cranktrain.main_fillet_fit`).  The bending peak of (b) is the official (c) peak scaled by the ratio of the M53 journal-fillet bending factors, which differ only in f_B(r) = 0.1908 r^(-0.5568), r = R_G / D (M53.3.3, p. 19): (2.5 / 1.6)^(-0.5568) = 0.780 - the nominal web bending stress does not change with the fillet radius.  Main bearing per option: land width, specific load at the model peak and the quasi-static Ocvirk film at 6,700 rpm (the method of the dynamics report).
source: IACS UR M53 Rev.4 (2019): bending factor of the journal fillet M53.3.3 (p. 19), f_B(r) = 0.1908 r^(-0.5568), r = R_G / D; torsion factor M53.3.3 / 3.2; equivalent stress M53.5.2

bending_scaling.note: r_c = 0.029 is just below M53's 0.03; r_b = 0.045 is inside the range
